svg.text: 4. Scores for one tile: q [64] against K [128, 64] → scores [128]
last tile of a 300-token context: positions 256 … 383, only the first 44 lanes are inside the context
out-of-context lanes can never win or add

g.text: out-of-context lanes can never win or add

svg.text: the tile's best score → updates m

g.text: the tile's best score → updates m

svg.text: Why −∞ and not 0 for the masked lanes:
e^(0 − m) would add a fake weight to the sum;
e^(−∞) = 0 adds nothing. The masked LOAD gives 0,
the where() then turns that score into −∞.
